notes.title: Welcome to Hide the Corpse!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, fellow partners in crime![/h2]

It's time to get creative with your cleaning... but not the kind you’re used to. 💀

[h2][b]No time to explain but:[/b][/h2]

💀 There’s a body.

🕒 There’s a timer.

🚨 There are cops on the way.

Your job? Make the evidence disappear — and no, the “under the rug” trick isn’t going to cut it.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TjDWtsi.png[/img]
[h2][b]👀Rather questionable hiding spots in store[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Under the bed? Yawn
[*] Inside a time machine? Now we’re talking
[*]In zero gravity? *Chef’s kiss* 🌌
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/V71PnFN.gif[/img]
[h2][b]🎨Wild levels:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Blend into the art in the **museum** (is that a statue or…?)
[*]Try not to drown in the **shipwreck** (physics say hi).
[*] And the **spaceship**? Let’s just say Newton’s laws don’t apply.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Vn01cgf.png[/img]
[h2][b]🍏Unlimited freedom[/b][/h2]
Toss everything you’ve got at Gus — books, chairs, vases... see what sticks! Get creative and let the chaos unfold. 

[h2][b]🎭 Hide in style[/b][/h2]
The better you hide, the more you score!  Rack up enough, and you’ll unlock some killer costumes for Gus. Disco king? 🕺 Gus can do it all (or, you know, be it all). 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/7oTXFJD.png[/img]
[h2][b]🏆 Points, Please:[/b][/h2]
Time’s ticking, and the cops are coming, but don’t forget the details. Miss a fingerprint or leave evidence behind? That’s points down the drain. Clean up every last trace if you want your score to be flawless.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/sMLBmpb.gif[/img]

[b]🎮 Add Hide the Corpse VR to your wishlist now and be the first to get notified when the chaos begins.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3405120

[h2]🚨 Hurry up — the cops are coming! 🚨[/h2]

notes.title: FADES UPDATE IS LIVE!
notes.content:
Good Morning, Barbers!

We know that you have been asking for this update for a while… Shave & Stuff presents
- [b]FADES[/b]!!! 🚀

Yes, you heard that right! 👏

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44339064/107336e82f4d3ec3af8f16cd6a7d94dc02857d65.png[/img]



Now, show off your [i]creativity [/i]without any [b]restrictions[/b]! Give some top-notch fades to your customers without compromising on style! It’s time for you to unleash your skills and give them the look they’ve been craving.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44339064/b466cf972e061b0774fa1ab7e16aa10f4006d6e1.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44339064/169aae32004aecd00824dc2f58b2387a77bed3b9.gif[/img]

It’s worth mentioning that we have [b]tweaked [/b]the trimmer and now, it’s trimming hair where it's [b][i]actually placed[/i][/b]! 🥳

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44339064/de6cc8f7492638e3b6c120663bcaeca9e743f1a9.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44339064/8a44a401d314ec96c2614c53d9cdb9754ec83b08.gif[/img]


Thanks for all feedback! 🙌🏻💪🏻


So what are you waiting for? Let’s have some fun and dive into the world of endless possibilities and endless styles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44339064/45deeca2187d3596b7da4e0cc8cb902b9774cf85.gif[/img]

Don’t forget to check out our [b]Official Shave & Stuff Fades trailer[/b] on YouTube!

[previewyoutube=AKoCkCV3uQk;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you once again for all the love and support!

Happy Barbering! 🪒

- [b]Dev Team[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44339064/3be6c406ab154aa2ebc11cdecccd3f37e76b3d51.png[/img]
